title: Vector and Machine Revisited
author: Casper Quintana
blurb: Isandro Hartwell, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
